physical.name: Heavy Labor
physical.scope: Hauling, breaking, and forcing objects with raw strength — dockworker, quarry hand, or siege crew.

physical.name: Climbing
physical.scope: Scaling walls, cliffs, and ship rigging by muscle and grip — steeplejack, sailor, or mountain guide.

physical.name: Blacksmithing
physical.scope: Forging, reshaping, and repairing metal with hammer and heat — smith, farrier, or armorer.

physical.name: Masonry
physical.scope: Cutting, setting, and repairing stone, brick, and mortar work — builder, stonemason, or fortification crew.

physical.name: Wrestling
physical.scope: Holding, throwing, and controlling bodies in close struggle — pit fighter, town guard, or pit steward.

physical.name: Swimming
physical.scope: Distance, depth, and survival in water under strain — diver, ferryman, or salvage hand.

physical.name: Digging
physical.scope: Earthworks, trenches, graves, and mining cuts under time pressure — sapper, miner, or grave digger.

physical.name: Siege Labor
physical.scope: Bracing gates, raising beams, and manning rams under fire — siege engineer crew or castle laborer.

finesse.name: Lockpicking
finesse.scope: Opening locks and catches the way a burglar would, quietly and without force.

finesse.name: Pickpocket
finesse.scope: Lifting purses, cutting pockets, and planting small items in a crowd — cutpurse or stage magician.

finesse.name: Circus Acrobat
finesse.scope: Leaps, balance, and tumbling like a circus acrobat through tight or uneven spaces.

finesse.name: Trapcraft
finesse.scope: Setting, noticing, and disarming small traps, wires, and triggers by hand — tomb robber or locksmith.

finesse.name: Stealth
finesse.scope: Moving unseen through sightlines without force — scout, burglar, or night watch infiltrator.

finesse.name: Sleight of Hand
finesse.scope: Palming, switching, and planting small objects mid-conversation — con artist or dealer.

finesse.name: Rope Work
finesse.scope: Knots, climbing lines, and securing loads with fine control — sailor, rigger, or executioner.

finesse.name: Concealment
finesse.scope: Choosing where to vanish and leave no trace — poacher, courier, or urban shadow.

survival.name: Tracking
survival.scope: Following footprints and disturbed ground outdoors — hunter, bounty tracker, or ranger.

survival.name: Foraging
survival.scope: Finding food, water, and shelter in the wild — woodsman, pilgrim guide, or refugee scout.

survival.name: Animal Handling
survival.scope: Calming, guiding, and reading beasts without spooking them — wrangler, stable hand, or beast trainer.

survival.name: Weather Sense
survival.scope: Reading sky, wind, and storm signs before they hit — sailor, shepherd, or caravan master.

survival.name: Navigation
survival.scope: Finding routes by landmarks, stars, and chart — guide, navigator, or courier.

survival.name: Herbalism
survival.scope: Identifying wild plants for food, medicine, or poison — herbalist, midwife, or hedge witch.

survival.name: Campcraft
survival.scope: Building shelter, fire, and safe camps in hostile country — ranger, soldier, or expedition cook.

survival.name: Hunting
survival.scope: Stalking game and taking clean kills in the wild — hunter, trapper, or gamekeeper.

science-craft.name: Field Medicine
science-craft.scope: Stabilizing wounds and treating injuries under pressure — battlefield medic or ship surgeon.

science-craft.name: Tinkering
science-craft.scope: Repairing and jury-rigging tools, traps, and devices — tinkerer, siege mechanic, or clock-hand.

science-craft.name: Alchemy
science-craft.scope: Mixing reagents, solvents, and remedies safely — alchemist, dye-maker, or poisoner.

science-craft.name: Cartography
science-craft.scope: Drawing and reading practical maps of routes and sites — surveyor, scout-cartographer, or estate clerk.

science-craft.name: Engineering
science-craft.scope: Designing machines, fortifications, and load-bearing structures — engineer, millwright, or siege architect.

science-craft.name: Artisanry
science-craft.scope: Fine soft-goods and decorative craft: cloth, jewelry, finishing — tailor, jeweler, or court artisan.

science-craft.name: Apothecary
science-craft.scope: Preparing doses, poultices, and measured remedies from known recipes — apothecary or hospice attendant.

science-craft.name: Appraisal
science-craft.scope: Judging worth, authenticity, and craft quality of goods — merchant, pawnbroker, or customs officer.

occult.name: Demon Lore
occult.scope: Recognizing demons, their marks, bargains, and telltale signs — exorcist aide or cult hunter.

occult.name: Religious Lore
occult.scope: Knowing the old gods, faiths, and religious rituals practiced in the world — cleric, scribe, or temple guide.

occult.name: Ward Craft
occult.scope: Reading wards and seals others left, and understanding what was done there — warder or relic keeper.

occult.name: Folklore
occult.scope: Recalling local curses, omens, and old bargains — village elder, storyteller, or hedge witch.

occult.name: Ritual Theory
occult.scope: Reading ritual steps, circles, and what a working needs to hold — ritualist or circle scribe.

occult.name: Echo Signs
occult.scope: Spotting Echo marks, awakenings, and power-residue on people and places — Echo-watcher or inquisitor.

occult.name: Spirit Lore
occult.scope: Recognizing spirits, hauntings, and bargains with the dead — medium, grave warden, or mourner-priest.

occult.name: Forbidden Tongues
occult.scope: Reading and speaking fragments of old occult languages — forbidden scholar or vault librarian.

social.name: Cold Read
social.scope: Reading people in tense social stakes — interrogator, gambler, or court whisperer.

social.name: Persuasion
social.scope: Steering someone toward a choice they can almost already accept — advocate, recruiter, or diplomat.

social.name: Intimidation
social.scope: Pressing will through threat, presence, and hard stares — enforcer, sergeant, or debt collector.

social.name: Etiquette
social.scope: Moving correctly through courts, crews, and formal rooms — courtier, majordomo, or embassy aide.

social.name: Deception
social.scope: Selling lies and half-truths under scrutiny — spy, smuggler face, or confidence artist.

social.name: Leadership
social.scope: Rallying allies and holding a group to a plan under stress — captain, gang boss, or expedition lead.

social.name: Streetwise
social.scope: Reading underworld rules, fences, and city rumor — fixer, informant, or alley guide.

social.name: Negotiation
social.scope: Closing deals with leverage, terms, and hidden costs — merchant, broker, or hostage go-between.

investigation.name: Crime Scene
investigation.scope: Reconstructing what happened from physical clues left behind — watch detective or coroner’s aide.

investigation.name: Interrogation
investigation.scope: Drawing answers from reluctant witnesses without losing the thread — inquisitor, watch officer, or advocate.

investigation.name: Research
investigation.scope: Digging facts from records, ledgers, and archives — clerk, scholar, or estate auditor.

investigation.name: Deduction
investigation.scope: Connecting partial clues into a workable theory — consulting detective or case solicitor.

investigation.name: Surveillance
investigation.scope: Watching targets over time without being noticed — private eye, spy, or night watch.

investigation.name: Forensics
investigation.scope: Matching wounds, residues, and tool marks to causes — coroner, battlefield surgeon, or poison tester.

investigation.name: Cryptography
investigation.scope: Breaking codes, ciphers, and hidden writing — code clerk, spy handler, or vault scribe.

investigation.name: Search
investigation.scope: Methodically combing rooms, bodies, and caches for hidden items — customs searcher or tomb explorer.
